title: Coin Collect
blurb: A bright two-note coin pickup blip straight out of the 8-bit era. This is the sound of progress: play it when anything good happens — a donation on stream, a right answer, a successful parallel park. It's synthesized in the classic arcade style, so it's original audio you can use anywhere without worrying about rights. Short, punchy, and weirdly satisfying on loop.
origin: Original 8-bit style synthesis inspired by arcade coin pickups.
